notes: Healer 'infinite SP' mode. New ∞ SP toggle next to the Healer switch: in the gaps between real heals it keeps Close Wounds firing on you, so a build that returns spell points when it casts cure spells can sustain its SP loop hands-free. It never fires in place of a real heal, respects your spell points (so it can't drain you on its own), and casts without stealing your current target. Needs the Healer toggle on and Close Wounds on a hotbar. (0.6.1: corrected Close Wounds' cooldown to 1 second.)
